rules.cwe_name: Improper Neutralization of Argument Delimiters in a Command ('Argument Injection')
rules.description: Using user-controlled data as arguments to some commands, such as git clone, can allow arbitrary commands to be executed.

rules.cwe_name: Improper Neutralization of Special Elements used in a Command ('Command Injection')
rules.description: Externally influenced data changes the syntax or meaning of a command sent to a downstream command interpreter.

rules.cwe_name: Improper Neutralization of Special Elements used in an OS Command ('OS Command Injection')
rules.description: Using the  `cat` process to read a file is unnecessarily complex, inefficient, unportable, and can lead to subtle bugs, or even security vulnerabilities.

rules.cwe_name: Improper Control of Generation of Code ('Code Injection')
rules.description: Using externally controlled strings to construct code may allow a malicious user to execute arbitrary code.

rules.cwe_name: Hidden Functionality
rules.description: Writing network data directly to the file system allows arbitrary file upload and might indicate a backdoor.

rules.cwe_name: Creation of Temporary File With Insecure Permissions
rules.description: Creating a temporary file that is accessible by other users can lead to information disclosure and sometimes remote code execution.

rules.cwe_name: Improper Encoding or Escaping of Output
rules.description: Replacing a substring with itself has no effect and may indicate a mistake.

rules.cwe_name: Operator Precedence Logic Error
rules.description: Nested expressions involving binary bitwise operators and comparisons are easy to misunderstand without additional disambiguating parentheses or whitespace.

rules.cwe_name: Improper Control of Resource Identifiers ('Resource Injection')
rules.description: creating arbitrary environment variables from user controlled data is not secure

rules.cwe_name: Storage of File with Sensitive Data Under Web Root
rules.description: Exposing a node_modules folder, or the project folder to the public, can cause exposure of private information.

rules.cwe_name: Creation of Temporary File With Insecure Permissions

rules.cwe_name: Incorrect Type Conversion or Cast
rules.description: Assigning to a property of a primitive value has no effect and may trigger a runtime error.

rules.cwe_name: Hidden Functionality
rules.description: Writing network data directly to the file system allows arbitrary file upload and might indicate a backdoor.

rules.cwe_name: Dead Code
rules.description: An expression that has no effect and is used in a void context is most likely redundant and may indicate a bug.

rules.cwe_name: Improper Neutralization of Special Elements used in an OS Command ('OS Command Injection')
rules.description: Using the  `cat` process to read a file is unnecessarily complex, inefficient, unportable, and can lead to subtle bugs, or even security vulnerabilities.

rules.cwe_name: Assignment to Variable without Use
rules.description: An assignment to a global variable that is never used has no effect.

rules.cwe_name: Improper Control of Generation of Code ('Code Injection')
rules.description: Using externally controlled strings to construct code may allow a malicious user to execute arbitrary code.
